public_corroboration.claim: Administrator Center contains Firmware List, Terminal Management, User Management, Role Management; grid selects available marketplaces/portals; support email is paxstore.support@pax.us.
Terminal Management and Firmware List are role-controlled and may be Full or Readonly.
Current public knowledge base exposes Terminal Management training material.
Official public release article is V10.0 posted 2026-01-06; this does not redefine the separately captured portal footer build label.

non_claims: App Store search results do not prove absence of all Administrator Center entitlements.
These captures do not prove membership in the estate that owns Kiosk4.
These captures do not prove Kiosk4 current firmware or installed app/package state.
The captured v11.0.4_20260814180314 footer string is not promoted to official release semantics.
